high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram Explore page featuring a post from the account "spaceman.in." The post includes a visually striking image of a spiral galaxy with vibrant colors, primarily shades of purple, pink, and blue, set against a dark background dotted with stars. The central part of the galaxy appears brighter, with a yellowish hue, suggesting the presence of a supermassive black hole at its core. The text overlay on the image reads: "Stars orbit around the galaxy..." with the word "galaxy" highlighted in green.
